published_baseline: Founder-directed restoration of the historical Supabase-style ongoing Intelligence NEWS FEED but without Supabase. First-party official sources remain free, read-only and original-dated; private publisher article titles, URLs, raw feeds and article bodies are NEVER stored or displayed. A no-cost GitHub Actions publisher polls all 3 categories every 30 minutes, creates independently derived Geomacro finds / What changed / Why it matters unscored news cards, writes only those derived cards into the already existing Cloudflare D1 control-plane via bearer auth. D1 retains 30d max, immutable original timestamps, stable per-release deduplication, automatic bounded cleanup, exact 15-minute original-source delay checked by producer, Worker and website. Existing on-demand 2-minute browser refresh remains immediate direct publisher fallback. Default All latest merges public 30-day journal and current live releases, old cards keep original date, no invented scores or corroboration claims. No B2 or raw provider storage, no browser durable storage, no Supabase. no x402 or GRI changes; independent 60m Global Risk remains. The new public D1 endpoint is for free derived newsroom continuity only and cannot mark legacy B2 hot snapshots or commercial x402 ready. User will manually publish only after exact-head source/test/security verification and Lovable sync; live acceptance separate.
policy: Public website presentation is frozen. Intentional website changes require explicit founder approval and a dedicated baseline update. The finalized /global-risk presentation is additionally protected by its independent permanent lock. Deployment publication is accepted separately by the exact-SHA live acceptance gate.
